meta.name: game-balance-check
meta.description: Invoke when the user needs to validate game balance, tune economy systems, analyze progression curves, evaluate difficulty scaling, or check reward pacing. Includes Monte Carlo simulation and statistical validation. Triggers on: "balance", "economy tuning", "progression curve", "difficulty scaling", "reward pacing", "Monte Carlo", "fairness check". Do NOT invoke for economy/monetization design (use game-economy-designer) or code review (use game-code-review). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证游戏数值平衡与难度曲线
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计或调整游戏内的数值与奖励机制。
copy.tagline_en: Validate game balance and difficulty curves
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or tuning in-game numbers and reward systems.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析游戏的经济系统、成长曲线、难度和奖励节奏，并用蒙特卡洛模拟进行统计验证。
howto.when: 当你需要检查游戏平衡性、调整经济系统、分析成长曲线、评估难度或奖励节奏时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个游戏的经济系统是否平衡。
say.note: Claude 会分析货币流入流出和玩家收益。

say.text: 分析一下这个角色的成长曲线有没有问题。
say.note: Claude 会绘制力量曲线并检测死区。

say.text: 评估一下这个关卡的难度是否合理。
say.note: Claude 会进行挑战-技能平衡分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you analyze game economy systems, progression curves, difficulty scaling, and reward pacing, using Monte Carlo simulation for statistical validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to validate game balance, tune economy systems, analyze progression curves, evaluate difficulty scaling, or check reward pacing.

say_en.text: Check if this game's economy is balanced.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze faucet/sink rates and player earn rates.
Claude will map power curve and detect dead zones.

say_en.text: Evaluate the difficulty of this level.
say_en.note: Claude will perform challenge-skill balance assessment.
